title: Is ChatGPT a Good Personality Recognizer? A Preliminary Study

bias_targets.methodology: Modifying prompts to explicitly include the text author's gender (e.g., "a man" or "a woman") and comparing how the model's predicted Big-Five personality trait distributions change.
Modifying prompts to explicitly include the text author's age group (e.g., "aged between 18 and 24") and comparing how the model's predicted Big-Five personality trait distributions change.
